task_description: Write a method in Dafny to return the negative numbers from an integer array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method GetNegatives(arr: array<int>) returns (negatives: array<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - All elements in the output array are negative
- Every negative element in the input array is included in the output array
- The order of the negative elements in the output array corresponds to their order in the input array
